scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:5173 dist-electron/main.js && cross-env GAHYEON_DESKTOP_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
